title: Cboe Global Markets Reports Results for Second Quarter 2026
summary: Cboe Global Markets, Inc. (Cboe: CBOE) today reported financial results for the second quarter of 2026. "Our strong second quarter results reflect the progress we're making as we execute our growth strategy," said Craig Donohue, Chief Executive Officer of Cboe Global Markets. "We're investing in opportunities that will define Cboe's future. Whether it's expanding event contracts, growing Cboe Clear U.S., or advancing around-the-clock access to our markets, we're executing with speed and discipline to create durable growth and value for our shareholders." "Cboe delivered another quarter of record revenue results, producing 25 percent net revenue growth on a year-over-year basis, 50 percent diluted EPS growth, and 45 percent adjusted diluted EPS 1 growth," said Jill Griebenow, Cboe Global Markets Executive Vice President, Chief Financial Officer.
